meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用本机 Ollama 模型：列出已装模型、向指定模型发提示并取回回复；若开启管理开关，还能拉取/删除模型、查看详情及内存中运行的模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 Ollama 处理任务（如“用 ollama 回答某问题”）时触发；若启用管理工具，要求拉取、删除或查看模型时也会触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都是什么
say.note: 会先列出可用模型，再用生成工具回答。

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型正在内存中运行？
say.note: 需开启管理工具，会调用 list_running 工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local Ollama models: list installed models, send a prompt to a chosen model and get a response; if the admin flag is on, it can also pull/delete models, show details, and list models loaded in memory.
howto.when_en: This triggers when the user asks Claude to use Ollama for a task (e.g., "use ollama to answer..."). With admin tools enabled, it also triggers on requests to pull, delete, or inspect models.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: It will list models first, then generate an answer.
Requires OLLAMA_ADMIN_TOOLS=true; calls the pull tool.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Requires admin tools; calls the list-running tool.
